## Description

The trusted main→staging convergence integration (#4229, staging `aff62acea197d0a9495bb5891b97d38df27b99df`) merged main's App-layer header/workspace spacing into staging's Files capability. The App 390×844 Workspace/Files visual baseline `app-workspace-linux.png` (pinned by #3971 on staging) no longer matches the merged tree's rendering: `fixture-visual-app.spec.ts:470` fails by 1408 pixels (~1%). This blocks the staging→main promotion #3815, whose required exact-head `e2e-tests.yml` check fails (run 44867696748).

## Reproduction

1. Converge main into staging (integration #4229 → `aff62acea`).
2. Run promotion #3815 exact-head e2e (run 44867696748).
3. `tests/browser/fixture-visual-app.spec.ts:470 › App 390×844 › Workspace / Files` fails: `toHaveScreenshot('app-workspace.png')` reports 1408 pixels (ratio 0.01) different vs `app-workspace-linux.png`.

## Root Cause

Verified: the FileViewer toolbar classes and the shell token values (`--nession-shell-space-1`, `--nession-workspace-editor-head-pad-x`, `--nession-control-sm`) are byte-identical across staging `a19633cf1`, main `158f94e68`, and merged `aff62acea`. The pixel shift (path bar ~9px, code content ~15px down) is the legitimate consequence of integrating main's App-layer header/workspace spacing into staging — the pinned staging baseline predates the integration. This is post-merge baseline drift, not a code regression.

## Impact

Promotion #3815 (staging→main) cannot qualify: its required exact-head `e2e-tests.yml` check fails on the drifted baseline. #4077 is already retired/MERGED; this is the remaining convergence blocker.

## Fix Direction

Canonical post-merge baseline regeneration (design-owner approval granted for this repair): dispatch `e2e-tests.yml` with `update_visual_snapshots=true` on a staging-based branch (the merged tree), copy only the legitimately-drifted PNGs into `e2e/tests/browser/__snapshots__/`, update `e2e/tests/browser/migration-parity.json` `baseline_png_blobs` pins via `git hash-object`, verify `node e2e/runner/cli-selftest.mjs`, and land a repair PR to staging. Do not regenerate from a pre-merge branch; do not sweep unrelated drift.

## Location

- `e2e/tests/browser/__snapshots__/fixture-visual-app.spec.ts/app-workspace-linux.png`
- `e2e/tests/browser/migration-parity.json`

### Success Criteria

- [ ] SC-01: The regenerated App visual baselines and updated migration-parity.json blob pins are consistent and exact-head web-check (including e2e/runner/cli-selftest.mjs manifest verification) passes on the repair PR head with no regression.
- [ ] SC-02: Exact-head fixture-visual e2e execution (app-workspace App 390×844 Workspace/Files) passes on the repair PR head against the regenerated linux baselines.

SC → scenario mapping: SC-01 = PR-head authenticated CI/Gate execution receipts (source-aligned manifest/regression check); SC-02 = PR-head browser visual execution receipts. Both `when: pr`, `method: agent` over authenticated exact-head evidence; no Full E2E obligation.
